title: You can do it!
text: Last week, Bobby and Sam saw a new poster at school.
Sam: Bobby, why don't you take part?
Bobby: Er, I'm not good at singing.
Sam: But you like singing! Have a go!
Bobby practised singing in the morning.
Bobby practised singing in the afternoon.
Bobby practised singing in the evening.
